commands.command: TBD: sweep lower update strength or stronger retention anchor on the M122 zero-relvel objective, then repeat behavior and hidden-envelope probes against M105 and M123
commands.name: m124_retention_calibrated_zero_relvel_objective

decision_rule: Admit an objective recipe for formal repeat only if it preserves M123's M122-loss improvement and zero-response behavior gap while avoiding yaw hidden-envelope regression.
failure_criteria: normal behavior success or clearance retention regresses
yaw response-hidden lift remains materially below M105
the recipe requires relaxing the zero-relvel input contract
hypothesis: M123 proves the M122 snippets are optimizable, but the 120-step update shifts behavior enough to regress yaw hidden-envelope lift. A smaller or more strongly anchored update may keep the useful zero-response behavior gap without damaging yaw belief.
success_criteria: M122 fixed-batch loss improves on repeated seeds
yaw response-hidden lift is not worse than M105 by the M123 regression magnitude
